sections.Profile:
Hi-Score Pool , released by Chicago Coin in August 1971, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wendell McAdams with artwork by Christian Marche. The game features a pool and billiards theme, with two flippers and a unique turret shooter, controlled by the right flipper button, which launches the ball into play.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme, 1970s, Playfield Gimmick
